admin.empty.tenants: A tenant is an organisation with its own users and folders.
admin.empty.admins: An admin runs this installation and its tenants.
admin.empty.users: The tenant's owner invites its people, or an app adds them through the API.
admin.empty.keys: An API key lets an app manage this tenant through the API.
admin.empty.audit: Sign-ins, changes to people and keys, and other actions show here.
manage.empty.links: Drop links and links that anyone can open show here.
manage.empty.people: People show here once an owner adds them and attaches a folder.
manage.empty.spaces: Team spaces show here once someone creates one.
manage.empty.largest: The largest files in this account show here, with their sizes.
manage.empty.activity: The latest actions on this account show here.
admin.empty.noMatch: Change the search or the filter.
admin.empty.people: Invite the first person to start.
admin.empty.groups: A group lets you share with several people at once.
admin.empty.labels: Add a field, such as a date or a choice, to describe items.
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Settings for the whole installation. A setting set in the server's config file can only be changed there.
settings.section.uploads.intro: What people can upload, and how much of the disk Selfcloud keeps free.
settings.section.sharing.intro: How long shares and links stay open, and how long deleted files and old versions are kept.
settings.section.signin.intro: How long people stay signed in, what they can search, editing in the browser, and what admins may do.
settings.section.about.intro: Facts about this installation. The server's config file owns them.
settings.locked: Set in the server's config file
settings.rangeZero: Allowed: 0 for no limit, or {min} to {max}.
settings.leave.title: Leave without saving?
settings.leave.body: Some sections have changes that are not saved. They will be lost.
settings.refused: The server did not accept this value.
settings.conflict: The server's config file now sets {keys}, so it can no longer be changed here. The page shows the current values.
settings.about.facts: Set in the server's config file
settings.note.lowering: Lowering it signs out, at their next use, everyone whose session is already past the new limit.
settings.note.office: Someone typing in an office document is signed out when this time passes with no other page request, since the editor's own traffic does not count.
settings.field.upload.max_file_size.help: The biggest single file anyone can upload.
settings.field.upload.max_chunk_size.hel: Big files go up in pieces of this size, and a dropped upload resumes from the last piece. Keep it under what a proxy in front of the server allows in one request (some cap it at 100 MB).
settings.field.upload.max_small_file_siz: Files up to this size go up in one request.
settings.field.storage.min_free.label: Keep free on the disk
settings.field.storage.min_free.help: Uploads stop when the disk has less free space than this, so the server never fills it. The database lives on the same disk and needs room to write.
settings.field.sharing.max_expiry.label: Longest share expiry
settings.field.sharing.max_expiry.help: A share can be set to end at most this far ahead.
settings.field.links.default_ttl.label: Download link lifetime
settings.field.links.default_ttl.help: How long a download link stays valid when the app that asked for it names no lifetime. It cannot be longer than the longest download link.
settings.field.links.max_ttl.label: Longest download link
settings.field.links.max_ttl.help: No download link lasts longer than this.
settings.field.trash.retention.label: Keep deleted files
settings.field.trash.retention.help: Files in the trash are deleted for good after this long.
settings.field.versions.max_count.label: Versions kept per file
settings.field.versions.max_count.help: Older versions beyond this number are removed.
settings.field.versions.max_age.label: Keep versions for
settings.field.versions.max_age.help: A version older than this is removed.
settings.field.sessions.idle_timeout.hel: A person who sends no request for this long is signed out.
settings.field.sessions.max_age.label: Longest session
settings.field.sessions.max_age.help: Everyone signs in again after this long, active or not.
settings.field.sessions.admin_idle_timeo: Shorter for installation admins, who can change everything.
settings.field.sessions.admin_max_age.he: Admins sign in again after this long, active or not.
settings.field.users.verification_ttl.he: New people confirm their account with this link before they can sign in.
settings.field.users.reset_ttl.label: Password reset link lifetime
settings.field.users.reset_ttl.help: How long a password reset link works.
settings.field.search.enabled.label: Search
settings.field.search.enabled.help: Find files by name and by the text inside them.
settings.field.search.office_text.label: Search inside Office files
settings.field.search.office_text.help: Read the text of documents, spreadsheets and presentations for search. Uses more disk and processing. Turning it on also reads the documents skipped while it was off.
settings.field.office.enabled.label: Office editing
settings.field.office.enabled.help: Turning it on or off, and the editor's address, need a restart of the server.
settings.field.office.discovery_url.help: The office server that Selfcloud sends documents to.
settings.field.office.lock_minutes.label: Edit lock
settings.field.office.lock_minutes.help: How many minutes a file stays locked to its editor after the last sign of editing.
settings.field.office.max_file_bytes.hel: The biggest document the browser editor opens.
settings.field.admin.tenant_access.label: “Sign in as” for admins
settings.field.admin.tenant_access.help: Lets an installation admin open a tenant's files as one of its people. Every visit is recorded in the tenant's activity.
